generation.fraction_constraint: positive mass fractions sum to one; detectability reported separately
generation.noise: Poisson applied once to physically scaled summed diffraction plus background

reference_variation.implementation: automatic per-phase reference_mismatch from LAB.md for every case, with element-specific coordinate RMS; curator-selected perturbed source registration using perturb_model.py remains available for larger deliberate variants

generation.selection: Research agent chooses cases and sources. Six is the initial batch size, not a lifetime case budget.

note: Lab-independent generator settings. Every property of the simulated laboratory comes from the lab settings block in LAB.md.

solver_evaluation.expected_counts: access only after prediction is frozen
solver_evaluation.profile_role: Primary term: profile = 1/(1 + D). Smaller D means the predicted pattern is closer to the true noise-free pattern.
solver_evaluation.structure_role: Secondary term: inventory, abundance, fractions and scattering-weighted site agreement; cell error reported only.
solver_evaluation.structures_and_fractions: CIF/result.json must agree with final.gpx within declared export-rounding tolerances

verification.alternative_solutions: retain strict recovery and profile-consistency results separately; report unanticipated alternatives for fixed-rule audit without outcome-driven scoring changes
verification.candidate_quality: separate nonnegative known-phase amplitude fit, explicitly not submitted quantitation
verification.later_score: Profile agreement (D from verified final.gpx replay against the hidden noise-free pattern) is primary, gated by physical validity; a secondary structural term credits inventory, fractions and scattering-weighted sites. Independent Rwp is a separate diagnostic.
verification.nuisance: Generation/self-consistency audit only: generating instrument, zero and background shape parameters known; observed-data scale, nonnegative background amplitudes and supported specimen search. This audit does not score solver submissions.
verification.role: Case-generation/self-consistency checks. Solver scoring is specified separately by solver_evaluation and scorer/config.json.
verification.submitted_solution: Legacy structure-only generation audit; final solver scoring is specified separately in solver_evaluation.
verification.weighting: 1 / max(observed_counts, 1) for submitted fits; 1 / max(noise_free_mean, 1) for detectability checks
